title: Grief Report
description: Easy grief reporting system between users and staff
body:
# Summary
Simple and easy to use grief reporting system to let users report grief / issues to staff members with a built in teleport system and discord alerts.

# Features
- Allow users to easily make reports for grief/stolen items or issues at a specific area & send notifications to staff in game and or through discord.
- Staff can easily teleport to reports & close them from the gui
- Players can receive close notifications and updates about their report

# Commands:
- /grief (/gr) - Help menu
- /grief list - Open GUI of open reports & closed history
- /grief report <message> - Report a grief at your current location
- /grief status - Check status of a report
- /grief teleport # - Teleport to a report
- /grief close # - Close a report
- /grief reload - Reload config


# Permissions
- griefreport.staff - Access to grief report staff commands
- griefreport.use - Access to make reports
- griefreport.reload - Access to /grief reload

# Config:

```
# DISCORD WEBHOOK INTEGRATION
DISCORD:
  ENABLED: true
  WEBHOOK-URL: ""
  USERNAME: "GriefReport"
  AVATAR-URL: ""
  MENTION-ROLE-ID: ""
  MENTION-ENABLED: false
  COLOR-NEW: 16711680
  COLOR-CLOSED: 65280

# SETTINGS
IN-GAME-STAFF-ALERTS: true
ENABLE-HISTORY-LOGGING: true
JOIN-ALERT-DELAY: 5
```
